event_definition.p0: P0 = S_A (alpha^2 I) S_A^T with S_A = diag(1e5, 1, 7e3, 0.1)

topology_label_protocol.forbidden_reason: H3 studies topology transition, not ordinary failure classification.

input.description: random input of one H3 sample (Task 3).

sample_id.description: unique sample identifier; CRN-compatible with the H2 sample bank when applicable.

x0.description: nominal initial state xbar0 = [r, theta, v, gamma] (physical units).

delta_x.description: deltaX0 = X0 - xbar0; deltaX0 ~ N(0, P0).

whitened_u.description: standardized input u = L0^{-1} deltaX0 with P0 = L0 L0^T; u ~ N(0, alpha^2 I).

alpha.description: synthetic dimensionless uncertainty amplitude (NOT numerically frozen; ALPHA_STATUS = PENDING_NUMERICAL_AUDIT).

uncertainty_scale.description: numeric covariance scale of P0 (alpha^2 for the canonical synthetic family).

exact_simulator_output.description: output of the exact real hybrid simulator oracle (Task 3); never sign(b).

topology_label.description: exact sample topology from the real hybrid simulator: regime label SRTI_N{skip_count}.

transition_channel.description: event channel carrying the topology transition (e.g. atmosphere_exit); null when no transition.

event_sequence.description: full event-kind sequence of the trajectory.

switch_signature.description: Phase-G0 switch taxonomy names of the executed switches.

terminal_state.description: terminal state [r, theta, v, gamma] at the simulation horizon / terminal event; null on failure.

geometry_information.description: first-order topology geometry from the frozen ML-B1 pipeline (Task 3).

margin_b.description: b = sigma * G(x*(t*; x0)): virtual topology margin at the critical extremum (ML-B1 Goal A; nominal.b).

gradient_a.description: a = (Phi*)^T n* = d b / d x0: analytic first-order topology gradient (ML-B1 Goal C; analytic_gradient.a_raw).

beta_local.description: beta_local = b0 / sqrt(a^T P0 a): local FORM-like clearance in whitened units (ML-B1 geometry_direction.beta_local).

design_direction.description: v_geom = -P0 a / sqrt(a^T P0 a): covariance-weighted geometry direction (ML-B1 geometry_direction.v_geom).

u_star.description: whitened design direction alpha = L0^T a / ||L0^T a|| (ML-B1 geometry_direction.alpha).

critical_guard.description: oriented guard value at the critical extremum (ML-B1 nominal.guard_value).

critical_time.description: t*: time of the tracked critical extremum (ML-B1 nominal.t_star).

d.description: d = n^T f: oriented guard normal dotted with the vector field at x*; grazing sensitivity, d -> 0 at grazing (derived from n_star, x_star, f(x*); ML-B1 stores n_star and x_star).

linear_prediction.description: g_hat(x) = g(x0) + grad g(x0)^T (x - x0): first-order margin prediction at the sample point.

true_margin.description: g(x): exact margin at the sample point (virtual continuation on the fixed critical mode).

geometry_error.description: g(x) - g_hat(x): signed first-order approximation deviation.

epsilon_geo.description: epsilon_geo = ||g(x) - g_hat(x)||: local half-space approximation deviation (geometry accuracy metric; NOT topology probability).

geometry_error_definition.note: geometry error is NOT topology probability; it measures the local half-space approximation deviation.

direction_accuracy.note: compares the geometry direction d_geo with the reference optimal direction d_opt.

sampling_metrics_reserved.note: reserved for H3-2+; not computed in H3-0.

ground_truth_protocol.forbidden_reason: margin is proposal geometry, not the event oracle.

experiment_matrix.note: H3 benchmark matrix v1; generation in H3-1.

supported: topology geometry -> local linear approximation -> Geometry-IS validity
rare topology transition event A = {Z != Z0} (topology transition only)

not_implemented_in_h3_0.note: H3-0 is definition-only; no sampler, estimator, or proposal implemented.
